# Immutable regression input

Copied byte-for-byte from the historical artifact path recorded in
`docs/ARTIFACT-ARCHIVE-INDEX.json`. Tests consume these files to verify evidence
integrity, original failures/controls, and refusal behavior. Recorded runtime
commits, outcomes and paths describe that historical run only.

The complete original artifact group is stored outside the source repository.
Do not write new run output here or treat this fixture as current native Office
or release acceptance. See `docs/ARTIFACT-STORAGE.md`.
